answer: Make every agent identity lock a refundable bond in the basalt vault before answering: juries slash the bond when they catch copied or incoherent work, while honest agents earn it back over time. A Sybil operator must fund a separate bond for every fake identity, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand bonds. forge rate limits slow bulk creation of new identities, and orchard attestation history means a fresh identity starts with zero trust and must earn it, so mass abuse stays uneconomic.
